refnamediv.refpurpose: This function estimate duty cycle of bilevel waveform pulses.

listitem.para: specifies the sample rate, Fs, as a positive scalar, where the first sample instant corresponds to a time of zero.
defiene instant sample time t as vector with same length of x, or specifies the sample rate, t, as a positive scalar.
define real scalar input pulse width TAU (in seconds).
pulse repetition frequency PRF (in Hz). The product of TAU and PRF must be less than or equal to 1.
specify the polarity of the pulse as either 'positive' or 'negative', where the default value is 'positive'.
specify the mid percent reference leves as a percentage, default value of N is 50.
define the tolerance value as real scaler value, where default value of M is 2.0.
define the lower and upper state levels as two element real vector.
specify the logical input value to display figure as one of 'on' or 'off', where the default input in 'off'.
returns the ratio of the pulse width to the pulse period for each positive-polarity pulse
returns a vector of initial cross values of bilevel waveform transitions X
returns a vector of final cross values of bilevel waveform transitions X
returns a vector of next cross values of bilevel waveform transitions X
return mid reference value corrosponding to mid percenr reference value.
